messages.content: Help me write a post-apocalypse RPG adventure around this idea: The player characters are scavenging a corporate complex, and they encounter a pair of deactivated android replicants. These are machines programmed to act as CEOs, but only they can open up a stash of pre-War technologies.  Use only words with lengths that are prime numbers.

message.content:
Two scouts seek the site. A tower looms high. Dust clogs every vent. The air is thick and stale. They breach the gate. Inside, dark halls stretch far.

They find a vault. Two bots stand still. These are not men. They are machines made for rule. Their eyes glow dim blue. Code locks seal the door.

One bot turns head. It speaks in low tone: "Identity? Verify access." The other bot nods slow. "Proof required to pass."

The group must act now. They search the floor. A key card is found. One hand holds it tight. The bot scans the chip. Light shifts from red to green. Locks click open with a hum.

Inside, gold tech glows bright. Pre-war gear waits there. Guns and meds are stacked high. No more fear of the wild. This find will save your life. Take what you need, then go. The bots return to sleep. Silence fills the room once more.
